time_origin: Seconds since HW1 capture start; fit subtracts 60 seconds.
selection: Original HW1 columns and row order retained; only capture time [60,270) rows included.
workload: Original IP length including headers; retransmissions retained, not application goodput.
source_limitations: Nine complete fitted ON-OFF cycles; independent empirical draws preserve marginals, not measured dependence.
Synthetic open-loop workload has no TCP or player feedback.

assistance.scope: HW2 planning, model reuse, source and shaper implementation, experiment and plotting code, analysis, LaTeX formatting and report text; actual scope recorded transparently.

source_sha256_scope: Original local HW1 CSV bytes before Git newline canonicalization.
fitting_serialization: UTF-8 CSV with LF newlines; original columns, numeric strings and row order retained.
